title: The exhausted admission hold says "This invocation's outcome is unknown" for dispatch_budget_exhausted, which sent nothing
outcome: EngramSpentInvocation::of_cause (src/engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs) classifies only begin_preparation_unacknowledged and begin_preparation_pending as NotSent, so dispatch_budget_exhausted falls through to Unknown. On the path where the budget expires before evaluate (evaluate_engram_turn_off_lock, local_hold with remote_application NotStarted), a spent window's preview and card say "This invocation's outcome is unknown." although nothing was sent. The wording should follow the recorded NotStarted classification, with no claim about earlier attempts, and a regression should cover exhaustion before transport.
acceptance: When automatic admission exhausts with last cause dispatch_budget_exhausted recorded as NotStarted, the exhausted hold's preview and card do not say the invocation's outcome is unknown, and make no claim about earlier attempts; a regression test drives exhaustion before transport and asserts the wording.
